_comment: A limited collection (v2 Phase 4): what a player owns, not what they field. 'Sorry 12' is the start of the v3 run in miniature -- 14 health of small and medium dice across both species, one dragon and three terrains -- and the smallest real test of the builder's limited mode. Two health over the 12-health cap on purpose, so building from it is a choice and not a transcription. Its contents are a v3 design question; this is only a plausible one. Hand-authored; no importer touches this directory. Counts are copies owned. Loaded and checked by src/data/collections.ts.
